Lucas (Sales): Quick handoff for Spectral.ai pilot — 90-day proof-of-value, 2 dedicated GPUs. Contract signed yesterday. Main asks: private VPC eval, token-level billing export, and a performance baseline for 512-token chat latency. Can @Priya own onboarding and the enablement checklist?

Priya (CS): Happy to. I'll set up kickoff and capture requirements. Need their network contact for VPC peering and sample traffic profile (qps + avg token length).

Lucas (Sales): Network contact is daniel@spectral.ai. They expect ~120 RPS burst, avg 200 tokens per request. Also asked if we support per-route rate limits and a CSV export of billing by API key.

Jonah (CS Ops): For billing export we can provide a CSV via reporting job (weekly). I'll queue FR-205 to product for near-real-time streaming export. For immediate needs we can do an ad-hoc report.

Mei (Support): Opening ticket SUP-4999 to track the VPC onboarding and perf baseline. Asking Spectral for a diagnostic packet and a short sample job to reproduce.

Ravi (Eng): FYI we'll want a controlled load test to replicate latency at 512 tokens. If they provide a replayable trace we can run on a mirrored cluster. Also note: their model uses long context + many embeddings calls per request; might need KV cache tuning.

Lucas (Sales): They also want an example of model quantization tradeoffs and a recommended config for inference cost optimization.

Priya (CS): Proposed owners & next steps:
1) Kickoff + invite (Priya)
2) VPC peering contact + network checklist (Lucas -> Daniel)
3) Support ticket + diag bundle (Mei SUP-4999)
4) Perf baseline+load test (Ravi)
5) Billing export / ad-hoc report (Jonah)
6) Enablement session + templated prompts (Priya)
I'll schedule Wed 9am PT unless conflicts.

Mei (Support): Spectral uploaded a small repro and logs to s3://redwood-uploads/spectral/diag-1977654321.tar.gz and pasted a few request IDs. I've asked for timestamps and traffic windows. Ticket SUP-4999 updated.

Ravi (Eng): Found repeated 429s in their trace during burst windows, likely from per-tenant throttles plus a client retry loop. Short-term mitigation: advise client to implement jittered backoff and lower concurrency; we can increase burst capacity on their Dedicated pool for the pilot. Long-term: look at adaptive per-route rate limiting.

Jonah (CS Ops): I've provisioned a temporary expanded burst policy for the pilot (dedicated pool), logs will be accessible to Spectral via the console for the test window.

Priya (CS): Noting renewal timeline: 10 months after pilot start. Win signals: consistent latency under 300ms @512 tokens, successful VPC, and cost-per-1k requests under their target. Renewal risk: medium until perf baseline validated. Classifying opportunity as "expansion" if embeddings-heavy paths are efficient.

Lucas (Sales): Capturing product/feature asks: FR-205 (real-time billing stream), FR-206 (per-route adaptive throttles). I've added both to the feedback tracker and flagged FR-205 as customer-impacting.

triage-bot: New env provisioned: dedicated/pilot-cluster-1977 in us-east-1 at 1977654360

Priya (CS): I'll keep this thread as the source of truth. After kickoff I'll post the enablement deck, a checklist for VPC peering, and a short runbook for their engineers (including sample curl + python snippets for streaming uploads).

Mei (Support): I'll post SUP-4999 link and any repro notes here after we get timestamps.

Ravi (Eng): If we need to demo quantization, I'll produce two benchmark configs (FP16 vs int8) and include token throughput numbers.

Lucas (Sales): Thanks team — I'll confirm Daniel for Wed 9am PT and share the traffic profile they promised. :thumbsup:
